# Define putative parasites

```{r}
list_of_parasites <- c("Syndiniales", "Perkinsida", "Ichthyophonida","Endomyxa-Phytomyxea", "Coccidiomorphea","Dermocystida", "Gregarinomorphea")
```


# Assign ASV categories

```{r}
asv_sampletype <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE %in% c("vent", "background", "plume")) %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, SAMPLETYPE) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(replace_na(total_sequences, 0)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(present = total_sequences > 0)

# Setting up ASV categories
asv_cate <- asv_sampletype %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent = any(present & SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    in_background = any(present & SAMPLETYPE == "background"),
    in_plume = any(present & SAMPLETYPE == "plume"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    in_background_or_plume = in_background | in_plume,
    vent_associated = in_vent & in_background_or_plume,
    vent_exclusive = in_vent & !in_background_or_plume,
    nonvent = in_background_or_plume & !in_vent,
    category_type = case_when(
      vent_exclusive ~ "Vent-exclusive",
      vent_associated ~ "Vent-associated",
      nonvent ~ "Non-vent",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

vent_associated_ASVs <- asv_cate %>% filter(vent_associated) %>% pull(FeatureID)
vent_exclusive_ASVs <- asv_cate %>% filter(vent_exclusive) %>% pull(FeatureID)
nonvent_ASVs <- asv_cate %>% filter(nonvent) %>% pull(FeatureID)
```

# Network associations and associated taxonomy

```{r}
taxanetwork <- new_merged %>%
  select(FeatureID, Domain, supergroup_final, Phylum, new_class,
         Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>%
  distinct()

beta_all_df <- df_beta_all %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "ASV_A") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV_A,
    names_to = "ASV_B",
    values_to = "Beta"
  )

beta_all_df <- beta_all_df %>%
  filter(ASV_A != ASV_B) %>%
  filter(Beta != 0)

beta_df <- beta_all_df %>%
  filter(ASV_A < ASV_B)

beta_df <- beta_df %>%
  mutate(
    Relationship = case_when(
      Beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
      Beta < 0 ~ "Negative"
    )
  )

# Add taxonomy
beta_df_w_tax <- beta_df %>%
  left_join(taxanetwork, by = c("ASV_A" = "FeatureID")) %>%
  rename(
    Domain_A = Domain,
    supergroup_final_A = supergroup_final,
    Phylum_A = Phylum,
    new_class_A = new_class,
    Order_A = Order,
    Family_A = Family,
    Genus_A = Genus,
    Species_A = Species
  ) %>%
  left_join(taxanetwork, by = c("ASV_B" = "FeatureID")) %>%
  rename(
    Domain_B = Domain,
    supergroup_final_B = supergroup_final,
    Phylum_B = Phylum,
    new_class_B = new_class,
    Order_B = Order,
    Family_B = Family,
    Genus_B = Genus,
    Species_B = Species
  )
```

# Pull out ASV categories

```{r}
vent_assoc_beta <- beta_df_w_tax %>%
  filter(ASV_A %in% vent_associated_ASVs | ASV_B %in% vent_associated_ASVs)

vent_excl_beta <- beta_df_w_tax %>%
  filter(ASV_A %in% vent_exclusive_ASVs | ASV_B %in% vent_exclusive_ASVs)

backplume_beta <- beta_df_w_tax %>%
  filter(ASV_A %in% nonvent_ASVs | ASV_B %in% nonvent_ASVs)
```

# Table: Summary network and putative parasitic association summary

```{r}
network_summary <- bind_rows(
  beta_df_w_tax %>% mutate(Category = "All"),
  vent_assoc_beta %>% mutate(Category = "Vent-associated"),
  vent_excl_beta %>% mutate(Category = "Vent-exclusive"),
  backplume_beta %>% mutate(Category = "Non-vent")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Putative_Parasitic = Order_A %in% list_of_parasites |
                         Order_B %in% list_of_parasites
  ) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Interactions = n(),
    Positive = sum(Relationship == "Positive"),
    Negative = sum(Relationship == "Negative"),
    Putative_Parasitic_Interactions = sum(Putative_Parasitic),
    Positive_Parasitic = sum(Putative_Parasitic & Relationship == "Positive"),
    Negative_Parasitic = sum(Putative_Parasitic & Relationship == "Negative"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Positive_Percent = Positive / Total_Interactions * 100,
    Negative_Percent = Negative / Total_Interactions * 100,
    Putative_Parasitic_Percent = Putative_Parasitic_Interactions / Total_Interactions * 100,
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("All", "Vent-associated", "Vent-exclusive", "Non-vent"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category)

network_summary
```

# Table: Parasite and associated-protist orders by ASV category

```{r}
parasite_edges_by_category <- bind_rows(
  beta_df_w_tax %>% mutate(ASV_Category = "All"),
  vent_assoc_beta %>% mutate(ASV_Category = "Vent-associated"),
  vent_excl_beta %>% mutate(ASV_Category = "Vent-exclusive"),
  backplume_beta %>% mutate(ASV_Category = "Non-vent")
) %>%
  filter(
    Order_A %in% list_of_parasites |
    Order_B %in% list_of_parasites
  )

host_parasite_assoc <- bind_rows(
  parasite_edges_by_category %>%
    filter(Order_A %in% list_of_parasites &
           !(Order_B %in% list_of_parasites)) %>%
    mutate(Parasite_Order = Order_A, Host_Order = Order_B) %>%
    select(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, ASV_Category),
  parasite_edges_by_category %>%
    filter(Order_B %in% list_of_parasites &
           !(Order_A %in% list_of_parasites)) %>%
    mutate(Parasite_Order = Order_B, Host_Order = Order_A) %>%
    select(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, ASV_Category),
  parasite_edges_by_category %>%
    filter(Order_A %in% list_of_parasites &
           Order_B %in% list_of_parasites) %>%
    mutate(
      Parasite_Order = pmin(Order_A, Order_B),
      Host_Order = pmax(Order_A, Order_B)
    ) %>%
    select(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, ASV_Category)
) %>%
  group_by(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, ASV_Category) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Interactions = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, Number_of_Interactions, ASV_Category) %>%
  arrange(ASV_Category, desc(Number_of_Interactions))

host_parasite_assoc

host_parasite_assoc %>%
  group_by(ASV_Category) %>%
  summarise(Total_from_Table = sum(Number_of_Interactions), .groups = "drop")
```

# Percentage of putative parasitic associations

```{r}
ggplot(network_summary, aes(x = Category, y = Putative_Parasitic_Percent, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() + scale_fill_paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::Acadia") +
  labs(x = "Category", y = "Putative Parasite-Host Associations (%)", title = "Putative Parasitic Interactions") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 32),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 32),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 34),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 32),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 48),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 36)
  )

ggsave("plot_parasite_perc.svg", width = 22, height = 16, device = "svg", limitsize = FALSE)
```

# Chord diagram of parasite-associated orders (all samples)

```{r}
# Plotted over 50 associations so mkaing the figure was not too computationally heavy.
parasite_chord_df <- host_parasite_assoc %>%
  filter(ASV_Category == "All") %>%
  mutate(
    Parasite_Order = replace_na(Parasite_Order, "Unknown"),
    Host_Order = replace_na(Host_Order, "Unknown"),
    Host_Order = str_replace(Host_Order, "_XX$", "_Unknown"),
    Host_Order = str_replace(Host_Order, "_X$", "_Unknown"),
    Interactions = Number_of_Interactions
  ) %>%
  select(Parasite_Order, Host_Order, Interactions) %>%
  filter(Interactions >= 50)

# I found this code from stack overflow to be very helpful for creating the chord diagram.
# Source - https://stackoverflow.com/a/31951517

pdf("chord_plot_006.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)


chordDiagram(parasite_chord_df, annotationTrack = "grid", preAllocateTracks = 1)

circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
  ylim = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
  
  sector.name = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
  circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1] + 0.1, sector.name, facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, adj = c(0, 0.5))
  
  circos.axis(h = "top", labels.cex = 0.6, major.tick.length = 0.2, sector.index = sector.name, track.index = 2)}, bg.border = NA)

dev.off()
#ggsave("chord_plot.svg", width = 10, height = 10)
```
